head_commit.message:
test(#978 r2): dong 3 P3 Codex luot 10 - dem muc oracle doc lap, chot ton tai moi commit dung

Codex luot 10 (approve db2c1f5, P0..P2 = 0) neu 3 P3 do phu, deu thuoc no
wp978-git-reader-differential-fuzz:
- git-reader-oracle-coverage-unlocked: dem so muc da so voi Git native, doi
  bang so muc dict cong muc SHA-256, dem doc lap tu `ca`;
- git-reader-write-receipt-assertion-unlocked va
  git-reader-negative-fixture-existence-unchecked: so (OID, co) ghi luc dung
  moi commit, ca fixture am va --literally; mot lan `cat-file --batch-check`
  doi dung "<oid> commit <co>".
Phan chung (Linux), deu rc 3:
- bo muc oracle dau / muc SHA-256: "oracle chi so 454 muc";
- doi byte hoac bo ghi fixture am #25 kem go chot OID: "... missing".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
